standard_prerequisites: Kripke models and the box truth clause at a world
validity as truth at all worlds of all models
core_obligations: Prove that if A is valid then Box A is valid
proof_roadmap: Fix an arbitrary model M and world w; any R-successor w' of w satisfies A since A is valid in every model at every world
The box truth clause then gives M satisfies Box A at w; M and w were arbitrary, so Box A is valid
difficulty_reason: A short semantic argument with one quantifier swap (all successors of an arbitrary world); the box clause must be applied correctly.
